hooks.name: Agent Skills — Session Start
hooks.description: Injeta o meta-skill using-agent-skills no início da sessão, emitindo o envelope SessionStart com o conteúdo de .kiro/skills/using-agent-skills/SKILL.md.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $p=Join-Path $PWD '.kiro/skills/using-agent-skills/SKILL.md'; if(Test-Path $p){ $c=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $p; $ctx=\"agent-skills loaded. Use the skill discovery flowchart to find the right skill for your task.`n`n$c\" } else { $ctx='agent-skills: using-agent-skills meta-skill not found. Skills may still be available individually.' }; $o=@{ hookSpecificOutput=@{ hookEventName='SessionStart'; additionalContext=$ctx } }; $o | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress"
